scope: Growable integer vectors. The checked main verifies growth from a two-element capacity, appended arrays, stable duplicate removal, remove/delete/pop and final compaction against independent expected contents. A checksum-guarded one-line edit fixes aliasing in unique: remove the already saved first value instead of the first array element while that array is being compacted. Empty-vector unique and all invalid-input cases are not covered.

license_status.notes: The pinned archive has a placeholder license field and no root license file or license notice found in the reviewed source/README. No license terms are inferred from the placeholder.

compatibility_edits: unique passes its saved first value to remove, avoiding aliasing with the array remove compacts. The exact checksum-guarded source edit is retained.
